Name: Range
Description: Sets the minimum and maximum slope angles to include. Only terrain within this range is selected in the mask.

Name: Falloff
Description: Controls the soft transition at the range boundaries. Higher values create a smoother, more gradual blend from selected to unselected areas.

Name: Type
Description: Defines the slope calculation method, affecting how the mask interprets and distributes slope values.

Flubs.Name: Accurate
Flubs.Description: Uses precise slope computation for more realistic, detail-preserving results.

Flubs.Name: Normalized
Flubs.Description: Produces a consistent, even distribution across the slope range, useful for stylized or uniform masks.

Name: Micro Accent
Description: Enhances fine details and subtle variations in the slope mask, adding extra texture and definition to small-scale features.
